fields.t: [s] host receive time since the first input (first motion / gripper change or first spoken word, whichever came first); messages carry no NUC timestamp
fields.stop: the task stopped for the correction (START): t [s] on the time axis of t, q [rad], gripper_open
fields.O_F: estimated external wrench in base frame (robot_state.O_F_ext_hat_K)
fields.J: 6x7 zero Jacobian at the end effector
fields.gripper_open: measured gripper state (width > 0.0725 m), newest value when the arm state was read
fields.language: Whisper transcript; segment and word start/end [s] on the time axis of t
fields.audio: whole recording (correction start to end) in recordings/; start = [s] of its first sample

language.text: You find the lid, cut well, you should lift it straight up like this. You also have to go over the toaster, power to ground and you should stop over the plate and go lower until the ground. When you touch the ground plate, you stop and open gripper. That's it.
